NO Gemini touches this path: captions + intent are pre-filled verbatim. Vision + method render via Vision.tsx (kind='vision', hook/stance/cta); example posts render via Example.tsx (kind='example', hook/spectrum/cta) with the spectrum outlets fetched live from the cluster_id. On-slide text is fit to the template budgets the way ig_generator does; the FULL prose always survives in the caption. Do not add em or en dashes.

hook.headline: You have never read the news.

stance.kicker: A front page, not a feed
stance.body: The same 50 stories, in the same order, for every reader. No account. No algorithm. No paywall. Every source scored for bias, out in the open.

posts.caption_instagram:
You have never read the news. You have read a feed built to keep you scrolling.

Void News is a front page, not a feed. The same 50 stories, in the same order, for every reader. No account. No algorithm. No paywall.

Every source is scored on six axes of bias, by fixed rules, out in the open. You see where each outlet stands before you read a word.

The news, dissected. See through the void.
news.voidvision.org

hook.headline: How do we decide what leads?

stance.body: No editor picks the front page. No AI judges the news. The feed order, the story grouping, and every bias score come from fixed rules, the same for every reader. Six axes per article, and every score shows its work.

posts.caption_instagram:
How does Void News decide what leads?

It does not. No editor picks the front page. No AI judges the news. The order of the feed, the way stories are grouped, and every bias score come from fixed rules that run the same way for every reader.

Six axes per article: political lean, sensationalism, opinion vs reporting, factual rigor, framing, and how each outlet tracks over time. Every score weighs both the outlet's record and the article's own words, and every score shows its work.

The one place we use a language model is the short summary under each story, and it is told to use only what the articles say.

Rules you can read. See through the void.
news.voidvision.org

#VoidNews #MediaBias #NewsTransparency #AlgorithmicBias #NewsLiteracy

hook.headline: One order. Two countries reading it.

spectrum.body: Trump cut the recommended childhood vaccine schedule from 18 immunizations to 11, calling it parental choice. The WHO defended the schedules within hours.

posts.caption_instagram:
One order. Two countries reading it.

Trump signed an executive order Monday cutting the recommended childhood vaccine schedule from 18 immunizations to 11. He called it parental choice. The World Health Organization defended the schedules within hours.

50 outlets covered it. On Void News you see the split at a glance: the coverage does not agree, and the page shows you exactly where it divides instead of averaging it into a calm gray middle.

Read the same event from every side, then decide. See through the void. news.voidvision.org

#VoidNews #Vaccines #MediaBias #PublicHealth #NewsLiteracy
